normalization_detail.weights_rationale: Weights are the source per-group residual injection-point counts (geotex/tcas_schedule.py BLOCK_DEPTH_MAP: mid->deep, up_0->deep, up_1->middle, up_2->shallow). The target has the same 4-point count, so point-count weights transfer 1:1 and the normalized weighted mean over the 4 target injection points is exactly 1.0.

target_mapping.rule: Order the 4 MV-Adapter injection points by decreasing resolution (equivalently increasing relative depth); assign source group sizes shallow=1, middle=1, deep=2 in that order. Topology/resolution/relative-depth only; no metric was consulted.

semantics: effective_scale(injection_point, t) = layer_multiplier(point) * temporal_scale(t); temporal_scale(t) comes from the already-frozen MV-Adapter global schedules (low=0.75, high=1.00, fixed_mean=5/6). Model weights stay frozen; scaling is inference-only.
